weathercoat.screen.title: Weather Coat
weathercoat.option.enabled.tip: Mobs and players get wet in the rain and snowy in the snow
weathercoat.option.players.tip: Apply the effect to players, including you in third person
weathercoat.option.stages.tip: How many steps the effect takes from clean to fully wet or snowy
weathercoat.option.catch_up.tip: A mob that comes into view during long rain or snow starts as wet or snowy as if it had been outside all along
weathercoat.option.distance.tip: Mobs farther than this keep their current look and are not updated
weathercoat.option.rain.tip: Only under open sky, in biomes where it rains
weathercoat.option.wet_time.tip: How long a mob stands in the rain before it looks one step wetter
weathercoat.option.dry_time.tip: How long a mob needs out of the rain to dry by one step
weathercoat.option.snow.tip: Only under open sky, in biomes where it snows
weathercoat.option.snow_time.tip: How long a mob stands in the snowfall before one more step of snow sticks
weathercoat.option.melt_time.tip: How long one step of snow takes to melt; twice as fast in warm biomes
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.weatherco: Mobs and players get wet in the rain and snowy in the snow, step by step, and dry off or melt afterwards.
weathercoat.option.puddles.tip: Puddles gather on open ground in the rain, rain drops ripple in them, and they dry up afterwards
weathercoat.option.ground_snow.tip: A thin see-through layer of snow settles on open ground and treetops in snowfall, then slowly melts
weathercoat.option.ground_radius.tip: How far from you puddles and snow film are drawn; a smaller radius is lighter on the game
weathercoat.option.frost.tip: Mobs and players freezing in powder snow get covered in frost and ice crystals
weathercoat.option.climate.tip: Deserts, sunshine and nearby fire, lava, campfires or furnaces dry and melt faster; swamps and jungles dry slower
weathercoat.option.particles.tip: Drops fall from wet mobs, snow falls off walking mobs, drying near heat gives off steam
weathercoat.option.skip_aquatic.tip: Fish, squid, dolphins, axolotls and other water mobs keep their look
weathercoat.option.skip_fireproof.tip: Blazes, ghasts, magma cubes, striders and other fire-immune mobs keep their look
weathercoat.option.excluded.tip: Pick mobs that never get wet or snowy
weathercoat.screen.excluded.title: Excluded Mobs
weathercoat.excluded.hint: Turn a mob off to keep it dry and clean in any weather. Grey rows are skipped by the water or fire creature options.
